page.layout: One page of text: a full-width title block at the top (the work's title and a summary line), then the chapter heading, then one column of text with a large initial M and numbered paragraphs. No margin notes. Page number at top right. No running head, because the page opens a division.

main_text.l: Hæc secunda pars agit de Mundo, de Cœ-
lis & Astris, de Elementis, de Mixtis,
corporum rectè dispositorum; corpora sunt instar materiæ[?],
cum mixta pareant, mundus essentialiter mutaretur.
corporeus & sensibilis; archetypus vero & intelligibilis est mundus idealis,
scilicet Deus; in quo est exemplar & idea mundi ectypi: Mundus
magnus est mundus sensibilis continens omnia corpora; parvus vero
est homo; in quo sunt omnia entium genera, cum habeat esse cum

page.notes: The Google watermark at bottom right is excluded. The page number is read as 55 but may be 35. "materiæ" is partly covered by an ink blot, so the letters "ri" are doubtful. "rectè" is partly obscured. "dispositio" is hard to read at the line break and may read "dispsitio" in print. "ectypus" is printed in italics and could be read as "ectypus" or "eftypus". The top of the page has a decorative ornament and a divider line, which are not printed text.
